title: Providence
overview: The film "Providence" is a story about change, about the near future. It asks questions that we are about to face. Is the future that awaits us dangerous or is it salvation? A short and debut, not at all perfect. But unique with its story. One of the few and almost missing Sci-fi films in Bulgarian cinema. Pilot, with an atypical approach, he requests a continuation... The plot tells the story of a young blind woman who regains her sight thanks to Artificial Intelligence. She soon begins to see images that do not correspond to reality. Doctors are faced with the difficult decision of whether to return her to her original state of blindness or... Inspired by the book "Jude" by Mina Kraycheva.
